summary: TruGolf Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 1.01 to disclose a binding Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Tru Golf Canada Inc., appointing the distributor as exclusive master distributor for specified Canadian and Hard Rock-related territories. Terms include a five-year term, no minimum purchases in year one, and conversion to non-exclusive if performance targets are unmet. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is involved; this is a routine distribution agreement announcement, thus classified as None.
